summary: Tightened the verify question's consequence in the honest direction rather than leaving an overstated exposure on record. The previous limitation treated the LeaderLeaseTimeout == HeartbeatTimeout boundary as an open route of ~10ms plus the election; reading the grant side shows the election cannot be that fast, because a voter refuses votes and pre-votes while it still knows another leader (raft.go 1673-1679, 1786-1792) and clears that only in its own campaign path, which needs HeartbeatTimeout without contact (227-228). No successor can therefore exist earlier than HeartbeatTimeout plus an election round, while the old leader leaves office by LeaderLeaseTimeout + minCheckInterval(10ms) <= HeartbeatTimeout + 10ms, so under validated timeouts the overlap is at most a few-millisecond residual and the practical route remains a stalled leader goroutine. Added those three source ranges, rewrote the limitation and the gap answer with the two-sided bound (gap still unresolved as a schedule-dependent condition), and added a concrete counterevidence item limiting the consequence. No execution requested; the question's evidence, executions and defect claim are unchanged.
